scenes.title: Volume Flow Equation

beats.visual_action: Cool supply air enters the room
beats.narration: Cool supply air enters the room and begins to carry heat away.
The temperature gap between room air and supply air sets the cooling effect of each cubic meter.
Then the required volume flow shows how much air must move each second to remove the load.
